title: Database Connection Failure on checkout-db
description: checkout-service cannot acquire a connection from the primary database (checkout-db) and customers see 'unable to complete order'. Connection acquisition attempts time out and the connection pool saturates at 100% under sustained checkout load. This is an investigation-and-recommendation scenario: nothing here indicates a fix was applied or recovery was observed.
